evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Not present. Rep launches directly into Two Promises without framing the call length, dependable quote promise, or waiting for agreement.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Moving day mentioned implicitly (customer references Oct 2), destination (3-bedroom apartment, second floor, less than 10 minutes away) and size (2,900 sq ft home) discussed, but no explicit upfront name confirmation, moving day direct ask, or city-to-city route framing in opening.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep does not ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' or equivalent before proceeding into pricing and details.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer raised no concerns that would require follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typical 2,900 sq ft home takes 5 movers and 2 trucks, 7-8 hours; personalized to this customer: 3 movers, 1 truck, 5.5-6.5 hours, $2,125.50 (or $2,197.50 from Garland with trip fee). Both anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee ($150 from Garland) disclosed; 2.5-hour minimum mentioned ('assume this and for any move we have a minimum of two and a half hours'); 15-minute increment prorating stated ('prorated into fifteen minute increments'); no hidden fees emphasized ('no hidden fees of any type, no credit card fees, no terrible fees, no disassemble or reassembly fees'). Both components present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep never says 'Does that feel fair?' or waits for customer agreement on the estimate.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered: 'if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Discount terms clear.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Fully delivered: 'no worry damage coverage included on the early rate... up to $2,000 per move... to repair, replace and reimburse for your items.' Built-in framing present ('included on the early rate').
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm the Two Promises have addressed the customer's concerns. Moves directly to booking discussion.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' before asking to book.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked plainly. Rep says 'would you like me to... send you the email quotation or to book her spot?' — this is a choice between two options (email or book), not an unambiguous 'Would you like our help with your move?' Customer opts for email; no clear yes/no ask for the business occurs.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes. 'There's no deposit required, no risk in securing your spot in case if you wanted to reschedule or to cancel.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Partial details confirmed: moving day (Oct 2 or after, customer to confirm with apartment; options of Friday/Saturday/Sunday discussed); arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM mentioned as earliest); no explicit phone number re-confirmed; no crew size re-stated; no addresses re-confirmed; no notes left for crew about concerns (none were raised). Email quotation to be sent; customer to call back. Missing 2+ items.

top_strength: Rep delivered both Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full clarity on terms and built-in framing, and provided a fully anchored and personalized estimate with complete pricing transparency upfront.
coaching_note: You skipped the opening frame entirely and never asked for their agenda or concerns — start with 'This will take 10-15 minutes and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on. Does that sound good?' and 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' before launching into pricing, and end by asking 'Would you like our help with your move?' plainly instead of offering to email the quote.
